faq.question: What is IntelliRide?
faq.answer: IntelliRide brings vehicle bookings, customers, rental handovers, returns and payments into one organized workspace for a vehicle rental business.

faq.question: Can I check vehicle availability before booking?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose a pickup and return time to find eligible vehicles. Confirmed bookings reserve the vehicle; drafts do not. Availability is checked again when you confirm.

faq.question: How do I track payments and outstanding balances?
faq.answer: Booking advances and later invoice payments are recorded against the rental. Finance shows the amount paid and the remaining balance. Refundable security deposits are tracked separately.

faq.question: When will I receive an invoice?
faq.answer: The system issues an invoice when an authorized staff member finalizes the vehicle return. Staff can then print it or download its PDF.

faq.question: Can employees have separate accounts?
faq.answer: Yes. Your administrator creates staff accounts and assigns the pages and actions each person may use.

faq.question: Can I use IntelliRide on my phone?
faq.answer: The workspace adapts to smaller screens. Tables may scroll within their own area so you can still review detailed records.

faq.question: Which package includes the AI Chatbot?
faq.answer: All three packages — Essential, Professional and Premium — include the AI Chatbot. Only Premium includes the AI Agent workspace, which remains a planned capability with no connected actions available today.

faq.question: How do I get started or request a demonstration?
faq.answer: Email ahamedsaadik1@gmail.com. We can discuss your requirements, package scope and setup. Prices and service terms are confirmed before purchase.

faq.question: How do I receive login access?
faq.answer: Your installation owner or organization administrator creates your account. Use those details on the Sign in page. The public website does not create an operational account automatically.

faq.question: How is access to business information controlled?
faq.answer: Staff sign in with individual accounts, and permissions control supported pages and actions. Your installation must also be configured and maintained appropriately; we do not promise absolute security.

faq.question: Can I use one installation for several branches?
faq.answer: Each installation is configured for one branch. Additional branches are set up as separate installations. Existing historical records are preserved during upgrades.

faq.question: Are prices and onboarding assistance fixed?
faq.answer: Contact the team to discuss package prices, installation and onboarding requirements. There is no online checkout or published support agreement on this website.

faq.question: How are refundable security deposits managed?
faq.answer: Deposits are received at handover and tracked separately from rental income. Any deduction needs approval. A refund requires a completed rental, a paid invoice and an authorized refund entry; money is not transferred automatically.

workflowFacts: The real pages are Bookings, Active Rentals, Returns, Invoices, Payments, Deposit Refunds and Reports. Do not invent different ledger or screen names.
Draft bookings do not reserve vehicles. Confirmed bookings reserve an eligible vehicle for the agreed period. Booking advances are rental payments and are credited once.
Security deposits are received at vehicle handover and are tracked separately from rental revenue. They are not ordinary booking advance payments.
A confirmed booking becomes an Active rental only after authorized handover. Actual pickup cannot be in the future or more than 30 minutes before the reserved pickup.

Returns require assessment, review and authorized finalization. Finalization issues the invoice automatically, including agreed rental charges and approved additional charges, tax and discounts where applicable.
Later rental payments are recorded against an invoice. Deposit application requires approval and is tracked separately from rental cash collections.

Deposit refunds require a completed rental, a Paid invoice, an authorized refund entry and sufficient held deposit. Refunds are never automatic bank transfers. Vehicle release depends on inspection/release approval, not payment or refund alone.
